note: One armoured boss who takes 75% damage — and his AI gets harder when he is hurt. Full move list.
title: Boss Rush

note: Four-direction beat-'em-up on the fighter rig: arrows walk, Z punches, X kicks. Clear three waves and the boss.
title: Street Brawl

note: Sumo on the fighter rig: tap Z then X alternately to shove — first one out of the ring loses.
title: Sumo Shove

note: Dodgeball with fireballs: Z throws low, X throws high; jump to dodge low balls, duck to dodge high ones. Five hearts each.
title: Fireball Dodgeball

note: Rock-paper-scissors grappling: Z strike, X guard, Up throw. Strike beats throw, throw beats guard, guard beats strike — and the CPU repeats itself half the time, so read it.
title: Grapple Duel

note: Hold the locker room against the dead for 45 seconds. Left/right move, Z or X fires. Every frame is drawn live by the cabinet's native 8-bit rig — no sprite assets.
title: Locker Room Last Stand

note: Fight through three dungeon rooms. Arrows move, hold Z or X to throw axes (auto-aims). Keys open doors, bone piles spawn monsters, food refills your draining health.
title: Crypt Gauntlet

note: Pick the plane, tank or archer at the start (left/right, then Z); the computer plays the other two. Loop-the-loop dodges (plane: press Z and X together), shoot red waves for POW, and beat the boss bomber.
title: Skyfire 42

note: The same Skyfire 42 mission with high-end shaded 8-bit sprites: pick plane, tank or archer (left/right, then Z) and the computer plays the other two. Plane: Z+X together loops. Beat the boss bomber.
title: Skyfire 42: High-End 8-Bit

note: The same Skyfire 42 mission as a painted HD world: sea, islands, harbours, clouds and lit explosions. Pick plane, tank or archer (left/right, then Z); the computer plays the other two. Plane: Z+X together loops.
title: Skyfire 42: Painted
